cards.card_text: God says a man who slaughters an ox, a lamb or a goat without bringing it to the Tent of Meeting shall incur ___ and must be cut off from among his people.
cards.verse_text: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD before His tabernacle—that man shall incur bloodguilt. He has shed blood and must be cut off from among his people.
